summary: FONAR Corporation filed an 8-K to supplement proxy disclosures for its going-private merger under an Agreement and Plan of Merger with LLC Parent and Merger Sub, both controlled by CEO/Chairman Timothy Damadian. The merger is expected to close following a special stockholders' meeting on May 28, 2026. The filing concerns supplemental disclosures made in response to stockholder demand letters alleging disclosure deficiencies; the company contends the original proxy statement fully complies with law but chooses to supplement to avoid litigation risk. No deal terms, price, or premium are disclosed.
